opportunities.name: Unallocated or unmatched meter volume resolution
opportunities.description: Volumes at a meter are unallocated, sit with the wrong party, or lack a covering deal, so logistics staff trace the cause and have the volumes reallocated, a deal assigned or the volumes written off. Follow-up and waiting for answers are common stalls.
opportunities.trigger: an allocation exception or unallocated volume at a meter
opportunities.output: reallocated meter or volumes cleared, with a deal or write-off

automation.idea: a standard exception investigation checklist and request email listing meter, days, volume and candidate deals
automation.why: each case restarts with the same lookups and the same questions to the same people

minutes_per_event.rationale: looking up meter statements and deals, writing the question to the right person, and chasing answers by repeat emails

opportunities.name: Extending an expired deal to cover flowing gas
opportunities.description: Gas flows or a sale is made after a deal or contract has expired, so staff ask to extend it or find the right deal so volumes can allocate or settle. It stalls while people search for the deal and wait for contract staff.
opportunities.trigger: volume or sale with no valid deal because the deal or contract expired
opportunities.output: extended deal or contract attached to the flow

automation.idea: a checklist for expired deal cases: find the deal, check term, request the extension, confirm it reaches the settlement system
automation.why: the same search and extension steps are repeated across emails and people

minutes_per_event.rationale: searching for the deal and contract term, writing extension requests to several people, and checking the result

opportunities.name: Monthly transport usage ticket entry
opportunities.description: Each month transport usage tickets are created, copied or refreshed with current rates and volumes, and schedulers confirm volumes. It stalls on obtaining third party rates and on attaching volumes.
opportunities.trigger: a new month when transport tickets are not yet in
opportunities.output: transport usage tickets with rates and volumes

automation.idea: a month-start checklist and copy-forward template for usage tickets
automation.why: tickets are re-keyed or copied by hand every month

minutes_per_event.rationale: copying prior tickets, looking up rates and asking schedulers to check volumes

opportunities.name: Sitara deal price correction
opportunities.description: A counterparty invoice or confirmation sheet shows a different price than the deal ticket, so someone asks for the Sitara price to be changed. It stalls on confirming the right price and on corrections needed before an invoice goes out.
opportunities.trigger: an invoice or confirmation price that differs from the deal

automation.idea: a price correction request email with deal number, days, old and new price prefilled
automation.why: each request restates the deal, days and prices by hand and is re-sent to several people

minutes_per_event.rationale: looking up the deal and prices, writing the request, and re-sending it to the person who can enter it

opportunities.name: Calpine daily gas nomination file
opportunities.description: A Calpine contact sends the daily gas nomination file, often after a call or conversation, and the volumes and path are confirmed internally. The work is mostly a repeated send and confirm step with little visible stalling.
opportunities.trigger: a daily nomination from Calpine, often after a call

automation.idea: a standard nomination intake checklist that compares volumes and path to the prior day
automation.why: the same file is handled and confirmed by hand each time

minutes_per_event.rationale: opening the file, checking volumes and path, and writing the confirmation

opportunities.name: Booking correction for Canadian and cross-counterparty deals
opportunities.description: Deals booked in the wrong book must be flipped to the correct book before invoicing and settlement. The request is forwarded to the team that can make the change.
opportunities.trigger: deals found in the wrong book ahead of invoicing
opportunities.output: deals moved to the correct book

automation.idea: a standard book-flip request with the deal list and target book
automation.why: the same request is rewritten and forwarded for each invoicing cycle

minutes_per_event.rationale: identifying affected deals, writing the request and forwarding it

opportunities.name: Gas price quote for a customer
opportunities.description: A customer asks for a price quote or hedge or forward volumes by phone or email, and the trader sends a quote and copies the right people. Replies depend on the customer calling back.
opportunities.trigger: a customer request for a price quote
opportunities.output: price quote sent to the customer

automation.idea: a quote email template with volume, months and price fields and standard copy list
automation.why: each quote is written fresh from a phone call

minutes_per_event.rationale: pulling the figures and writing the quote email
